copy.lede: Simon and the team at SPM Landscapes build patios, brick walls and steps, fencing and gates, pergolas and oak-framed buildings around Polegate and Eastbourne. Customers call Simon reliable, hardworking and very experienced.
copy.about_alt: Oak garages with ledged doors and waney-edge cladding, built by SPM Landscapes

services.title: Patios and paving
services.blurb: Sandstone patios, block paving and granite setts.
services.intro: Laid on proper bases with the right falls.

services.title: Fencing and gates
services.blurb: Close-board fencing, hazel hurdles and five-bar gates.

services.title: Steps
services.blurb: Brick and stone steps on sloping gardens.
services.intro: Safe, solid steps that suit the garden.

services.title: Pergolas and raised beds
services.blurb: Timber pergolas, decks and sleeper raised beds.

services.title: Oak buildings
services.blurb: Oak-framed garages and outbuildings with ledged doors.
